annotations.title: Record a statement of an account with holdings

description: Write what a broker’s (or any account with holdings’) statement printed — **the whole file in one call**: its movements onto the account, and its holdings table as dated readings. **You read the file** — a PDF, usually — and send what it printed; nothing here parses it. Each row is the **value date**, the description as printed, the signed `amount` (a buy negative, a deposit or a sale positive; a fee printed in its own column is already inside the amount), and `cash_after`, the cash balance the statement printed after it. A buy or a sale also names the `holding` and the `quantity` (bought positive, sold negative). **The balances are a check**: each must be the one before it plus the row, and the batch is refused at the first that is not — a misread figure. **They are also each row’s key** (date, amount, balance after), so an overlapping file — a half-year export repeating the months — adds only what is new, and the same file again adds nothing. A row of amount 0 naming no holding (the broker’s tax bookkeeping) is left out. `holdings` is the holdings table: per holding its `value`, and when printed its `quantity`, `cost_basis` and `price` (one unit, in major units — a price printed in agorot is divided by 100); `cash` is the cash line. Each is checked: the cost against what the holding’s rows put in by `as_of`, the quantity against theirs, quantity × price against the value, and the cash against the account’s rows. Holdings are named by id or name (`savings` lists them); a name the place does not have is made there. **Dry-runs by default**; the document is copied to a timestamped .bak first.

as_of.description: The day the holdings table is for, YYYY-MM-DD.

cash.description: The cash line of the holdings table, in major units.

commit.description: Default false. False previews; true writes.

file.description: Absolute path to the statement file you read. Hashed, so the same file is known again.

from.description: The first day of the period the statement printed, when it printed one.

holdings.description: The holdings table, one entry per holding but the cash. Up to 100.

correct.description: True when these figures replace a different reading of that day.

cost_basis.description: What it cost, as printed, in major units.

price.description: One unit’s price in major units. A check only.

quantity.description: How much of it, as printed.

value.description: What it was worth, as printed, in major units.

new_account.description: Instead of `account_id`: the name of the account to make, e.g. the broker’s name.

path.description: Absolute path to a .emd file on this machine.

place.description: The place on Net worth that names the account, when it names none yet — by id or name; made when new. Defaults to one with the account’s name.

rows.description: Every movement, in the order printed. Up to 400.

amount.description: Signed, in major units: a buy is negative.

cash_after.description: The cash balance printed after this row.

description.description: The movement type and the security, as printed.

holding.description: What a buy or a sale was in: a holding id or name.

quantity.description: How much was bought (positive) or sold (negative).

name: record_holdings_statement
title: Record a statement of an account with holdings
